statement: Fix the center template and the constants of Lemmas 4.5, 4.6, 4.7, and 4.9. Choose K, then an outer template with curvature less than −K in the prescribed capped region. For all sufficiently small scales in the sequence of Lemma 4.2, there are a parameter b ∈ [b−, b+], a pole x, center and active logs p, pi ∈ Gx, weights mi > 0 summing to one, and symmetric matrices H, L, V, Vi on TxM, with the following properties. For one selected index i, p = X j mjpj, E = span{pj − p} = Re, |e| = 1, q = p · e > 0, q2 ≥ cD, (5.21) mi ≥ m∗ > 0, pi = p + die, di > 0, (5.22) L ≥ 0, LE = 0, H ≤ L, H ≥ V + c b D Id − C b D2 pp∗ , V > 0, (5.23) Vi ≥ miL + cK b D2 pip∗ i , Vi > 0. (5.24) The center modified log and the selected outer modified log are nonconjugate. Let r and ri denote the reverse logs of these specified rays, let y = expx p, yi = expx pi, and set l = φ′ c(v(y)), li = φ′ o(v(yi)). The chosen true limiting branches are also nonconjugate, and det V ≥ c σx(p)2 σy(r/l) , det Vi ≤ C σx(pi)2 σyi (ri/li) . (5.25) Here c, C, m∗ are independent of K and the outer template. The level and norm-increment conclusions of Lemma 4.9 hold as well.
